propositions: The predates-gate guard shell construct appears 24 times across six workflow files with inconsistent application; two bugs (anxious-resistant-urson, sapphire-vulnerable-fruitfly) arose from copies drifting apart

A shared repo file cannot implement the predates-gate guard because it is absent on pre-gate trees and would fail resolution or skip needed gates, violating the existing parity test that runs guard bodies in an empty directory

Seven gate steps across four workflow files lack either a predates-gate guard or a mandatory-reason escape marker; five are legitimately guard-free and two represent genuine gaps filed as separate tickets
Every guarded step body must exit 0 and print the canonical 'change predates the gate' message when run in an empty directory with ${{ }} expressions substituted to empty strings
The parity test asserts completeness (each step is guarded or marked) and behaviour (each guard skips cleanly), generalizing the single-site mutation pin to all 24 occurrences
